column1: # Gap 278's bounded remedy: the (function, jurisdiction) -> verdict table AS DATA.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS.  P764: `algorithm0r/canvas-lms-mcp` is MIT and exposes grading,
# comments and rubrics.  It clears every licence check this KB has ever written and is
# GATED-to-PROHIBITED in several jurisdictions.  A licence-only shelf keeps admitting
# architectures that cannot be deployed.  Passes 59 and 60 wrote the two-axis pre-flight as
# PROSE in `compose/patterns.md`; prose is not readable by an instrument, so this is the data.
# BAND -- READ THIS BEFORE CITING ANY ROW.  Every row is `reported`, and that is not
# modesty, it is a measured property of the channel (Gap 270, re-posed pass 61):
#   - 12 of 12 primary policy hosts answer 000 to curl, AND so do example.com, google.com
#     and wikipedia, while raw.githubusercontent.com / pypi / npm answer 200.  The proxy
#     names the mechanism itself: `connect_rejected`, "gateway answered 403 to CONNECT".
#   - WebFetch against the same hosts returns EGRESS_BLOCKED.
#   So this session has exactly ONE regulatory channel -- a search backend's server-side
#   fetch -- and ZERO direct-fetch channels.  No row here can be payload-read, and no row
#   can be cross-checked against a second INDEPENDENT oracle.  A `verified` band on a
#   policy row in this KB would therefore be a defect, today and in any session that
#   PROHIBITED  - the function may not be deployed at all
#   GATED       - deployable subject to named obligations (assessment, oversight, logging)
#   MANDATED    - the jurisdiction REQUIRES the function be taught/performed
#   PROPOSED    - a bill or draft, not in force; never plan against this
#   UNREGULATED - searched and nothing specific found.  An informed gap, not a green light.
# REGION vocabulary (closed, five values, per the KB-wide convention):
#   North America | EMEA | APAC | LATAM | Global
